description: Rewind builds measured on one machine by tools/bench.py: one record per build, each workload's samples one per round, every round in a fresh REWIND_HOME. See site/bench/.

workloads.name: echo-cold
workloads.title: First run
workloads.description: `echo hi` in a REWIND_HOME emptied first: boot and teardown, plus packing the root into an image.

workloads.name: echo
workloads.title: Short run
workloads.description: `echo hi` again with another seed, the image already packed: what any run costs before its work.

workloads.name: compute
workloads.title: Computation
workloads.description: busybox awk adding 3,000,000 squares: no system calls, so the cost is the branch counter's clock.

workloads.name: spawn
workloads.title: Processes
workloads.description: A shell loop starting `true` 2,000 times: fork, exec and exit, the shape of a build's many small processes.

workloads.name: untar
workloads.title: Memory writes
workloads.description: Unpacking the coreutils source, 63 MiB, into the VM's memory and counting the files: pages written, which keyframes store.

workloads.name: cat
workloads.title: Late seek
workloads.description: `rewind cat` of a file at 95% of the unpacking run: restore the last keyframe before it and run forward.

workloads.name: check
workloads.title: Exploring
workloads.description: `rewind check` of 4 threads passing a token 2,000 times, 8 schedules 4 at a time.

workloads.name: hello-cold
workloads.title: First Nix build
workloads.description: `rewind nix` of GNU hello in a REWIND_HOME emptied first: packing the build's inputs into an image, then the full nixpkgs build.

workloads.name: hello
workloads.title: Nix build
workloads.description: GNU hello's nixpkgs build again with another seed, its inputs already packed: configure, make and make check, with keyframes.

workloads.name: hello-nokf
workloads.title: Nix build, no keyframes
workloads.description: The same build with --no-keyframes: what recording costs without the snapshots that seeking needs.

workloads.name: replay
workloads.title: Replay
workloads.description: `rewind replay` of the Nix build: run its inputs again from boot and check the trace comes out the same.

workloads.name: check-nix
workloads.title: Exploring a Nix build
workloads.description: `rewind check` of GNU hello's build in a REWIND_HOME emptied first: its unperturbed run, then 4 schedules 4 at a time.
